750730101.text: Ah, my savior! Thank you for your help in... defeating these hilichurls.

750730102.text: I was just standing on the cliff admiring the scenery, and one of them knocked me right out. By the time I woke up, I was trapped in here.

750730103.text: It's locked. The key... Ah, right, the key is in that chest over there. Could I trouble you to do me a teensy weensy favor?

750730104.text: I'd be eternally, utterly grateful if you would...

750730301.text: *sob* Freedom! Freedom from this prison at last!

750730302.text: This hot air balloon keeps on swaying this way and that. Heh, who knows, perhaps a gust of wind shall come and blow the whole thing down...

750730303.text: Even Granny Itztli would not be able to save us then, I fear.

750730304.text: Who are you, anyway, and how did you wind up here?

750730305.text: Ah, yes, I haven't introduced myself. Call me Conulaf, a trainee priest of the Masters of the Night-Wind...

750730306.text: As the title suggests, I'm currently in training to be a priest. I've stayed within our tribe all my life, so the elders told me, "why don't you go out and see the world?"

750730307.text: And so they kicked me out of the tribe under the guise of training—

750730308.text: Still, I wouldn't call getting caught by hilichurls the good kind of "seeing the world," would you, my savior?

750730310.text: Indeed, indeed! Were it not for you, I don't know how long I'd have remained trapped in there...

750730313.text: In any case, thank you so much for saving me, my dear savior... Now, after all this wind I've been subjected to, I should head down before giving my continued training more consideration...

750730314.text: I don't have much on me, but in my family, we repay kindness when it is shown to us, so let me give you these!

750730312.text: Heh... I fear you're not fooling me with that. There just aren't many adventurers as strong as you are in this world...

750730404.text: What happened to you this time?
